function.name: list_accounts
function.description: List available brokerage accounts for order routing.

function.name: list_positions
function.description: Read current positions from the database.

function.name: list_orders
function.description: Read latest order records and optional recent events.

function.name: preview_order
function.description: Validate and normalize an order request without writing to the database.

account.description: Account alias or account number when account_id is not provided.

function.name: enqueue_positions_sync_job
function.description: Enqueue a positions.sync job for worker:jobs to process.

function.name: enqueue_order_fetch_sync_job
function.description: Enqueue an order.fetch_sync job for worker:jobs to pull broker orders into the database.

function.name: enqueue_contracts_sync_job
function.description: Enqueue a contracts.sync job to fetch available contracts from IBKR into the database. Pass symbol and sec_type to sync a specific instrument (e.g. NQ FUT, AAPL STK). Defaults to CL FUT if not specified.

symbol.description: Ticker symbol, e.g. CL, ES, NQ, AAPL

function.name: lookup_contract
function.description: Look up contract details. Checks the database first; if no contracts are found, it queues a contracts.sync job to fetch them from IBKR and returns pending_job_id with no contracts. Tell the user to check back shortly, then repeat the lookup. Use this for informational queries like 'what is the front month for CL?' or 'what NQ contracts are available?'.

symbol.description: Ticker symbol, e.g. CL, ES, NQ, AAPL

contract_expiry.description: Specific expiry date YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. '2026-03-16'). Use this for weekly options instead of contract_month.

function.name: list_activated_products
function.description: List the futures products actively maintained in the security master (e.g. CL, NG, ZB, ZN, ES, NQ), with their discovered exchange, discovery status, and how many active contracts are in the database. Use this to see the tradable universe before looking up specific contract months.

function.name: list_watch_lists
function.description: List all watch lists with instrument counts.

function.name: get_watch_list
function.description: Get a watch list with all its instruments.

function.name: add_watch_list_instrument
function.description: Add an instrument to a watch list. Looks up the contract in the DB first. If it is not there yet, it queues a contracts.sync job to fetch it from IBKR and returns pending_job_id without adding anything: tell the user to check back shortly, then repeat the request. If it is found, adds it to the watch list and enqueues a market data job to fetch latest prices. Returns immediately with the result.

watch_list_id.description: ID of the watch list to add to

symbol.description: Ticker symbol, e.g. CL, ES, AAPL

contract_expiry.description: Specific expiry date YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. '2026-03-16'). Use this for weekly options instead of contract_month.

function.name: remove_watch_list_instrument
function.description: Remove an instrument from a watch list.

instrument_id.description: ID of the instrument to remove

function.name: check_watchlist_job
function.description: Poll a watchlist.add_instrument job for its result. Returns instrument details when completed, error when failed, or a 'still running' message if not yet done. Call again if still running.

job_id.description: The job ID returned by add_watch_list_instrument

function.name: trade_group_pnl
function.description: Realized + unrealized PnL for ONE trade group, matching the trade group detail view. Returns realized_pnl (settled), settled_unrealized_pnl, and the live-overlay figures intraday_unrealized_pnl / intraday_realized_pnl / intraday_total_pnl plus marks_as_of. Intraday figures are 'as of the last live TWS refresh', not tick-live, and are a per-group attribution (not additive across groups). For analytics across many groups use query_metric (e.g. realized_pnl grouped by trade_group).

group.description: Trade group name or numeric id.

function.name: query_metric
function.description: Run a business-analyst metric query over the trade database using the OSI semantic model. You pick a metric and dimensions by name; the server compiles them into read-only SQL. You cannot and need not write SQL. Not all dimensions apply to all metrics — if one is out of grain the tool returns an error naming the valid options; retry with those. Metrics — realized_pnl [grain: execution_facts] — Net realized PnL summed across executions (USD).; total_commissions [grain: execution_facts] — Total commissions paid (USD). Excludes synthetic combo summaries.; fill_count [grain: execution_facts] — Number of real fills (excludes synthetic combo summaries).; trade_count [grain: trade_facts] — Number of trades.; gross_premium [grain: execution_facts] — Net cash flow across fills (USD): premium/credits received minus premium/debits paid (SUM of signed proceeds). Positive = net credit collected, negative = net cash outlay. For a covered-call group this is weekly-call credits minus the long option (and stock) purchase cost.; premium_collected [grain: execution_facts] — Total premium/cash received from SELL fills (credits only), as a positive USD amount. E.g. covered-call premium sold to finance a long option. Filter sec_type='OPT' (and 'FOP') to exclude stock proceeds.; premium_paid [grain: execution_facts] — Total premium/cash paid on BUY fills (debits only), as a positive USD amount. E.g. the cost basis paid to open a long-dated option, or to buy-to-close short options. Filter sec_type='OPT'/'FOP' to exclude the stock leg.; open_position_count [grain: position_facts] — Number of open positions (position <> 0).; net_quantity [grain: position_facts] — Net signed quantity across open positions (long minus short).; position_market_value [grain: position_facts] — Total market value of open positions (USD, as of last sync).; settled_unrealized_pnl [grain: position_facts] — Settled (end-of-day snapshot) unrealized PnL across open positions (USD). Sliced/filtered by `trade_group` it is the per-trade-group figure from the detail view — NOT additive across groups (a shared position counts in each), so query one group at a time. This is the settled figure; the intraday/live unrealized is only in the `trade_group_pnl` tool.; win_rate [grain: trade_facts] — Fraction of trades with positive realized PnL, among trades that have a realized PnL value (i.e. that realized something). 0..1; breakeven (0) counts as a non-win; trades with no realized PnL are excluded.. Group-by / filter dimensions — account, contract_month, days_to_expiration, exchange, exec_role, executed_at, expiration, right, sec_type, side, status, strike, symbol, trade_group.

group_by.description: Dimensions to group the metric by.

filters.description: Equality filters keyed by dimension name.

start_date.description: ISO lower bound (inclusive) on executed_at, e.g. '2026-01-01'.

time_grain.description: Bucket the executed_at time dimension when grouping by it.
